pool_hook_two_stage_log_loss.plain_summary: Adding the half-point hook on whole-number lines to the served pick chance lowers the average miss slightly on seasons held out of fitting (about 0.0012 in log loss); it is very likely positive but small, and it changes 185 of 1,322 simulated pool-line picks for a net 3 more correct.
